title: drive solo_handback says implement in worktrees/solo/ but never creates it
detail: drive.py:414 raises solo_handback with 'implement in worktrees/solo/' after advancing to solo_execute and capturing RED, but no worktree exists (team mode creates worktrees/<role> via git worktree add at drive.py:465). The operator has to invent the branch name and create it by hand (pinned-engine: git worktree add -b sprint/pinned-engine-solo worktrees/solo HEAD). Drive should create worktrees/solo on a declared branch before handing back, so the solo path is as explicit as the team path.
